notes: no upstream JSON corpus exists; vectors derive from the pinned Rust test suite (see sources) and are codec cross-checked
nowhere-go/testdata/vectors is the module-local conformance corpus
complete wire hex tables must not be maintained by hand
nw2 auth salt is SHA-256("nowhere/nw2/auth-root"); tag = HMAC-SHA256(auth_key, transport || exporter || session_id)[0:16]
FlowHeader remains 5 bytes; flags high three bits carry HOPS 0..7 and flow_id is a 30-bit BE integer
OPEN/ATTACH may use equal carriers; Vector still emits DUPLEX when both directions match
mix is a client policy only; FlowHeader still carries TT, TQ, QT, or QQ
TLS Mux marker is 0xff after AuthFrame; MuxHeader is 7 bytes kind|value u16|flow_id u32
Morph TCP bootstrap is prelude[64] || nonce[12] with low7 (default) or full8 sender policy; UDP keys are directional udp c2s / udp s2c; incompatible with 2.0.x morph
setup result is a single byte (0..7); no magic/version prefix
UoT is u16 BE length + payload (no type byte)
QUIC UDP DATA/CLOSE are 4-byte packed headers, FRAGMENT is 12 bytes
